Nov 13, 2026
Nov 13 tuning update
A second Season 1 tuning pass, almost all buffs: longer damage ranges for the M4, Axion, Hyeon Burst, Cronen Squall, Oden, HAN 86, Kastov 762 and most SMGs, and the last damage drop-off is gone from several SMGs. Flinch you take is lower on every gun class except the Oris 8.6, where it is higher, and shooting through smoke no longer gets aim assist.
23 guns tuned · 5 tier moves
Nov 5, 2026
Season 1 update
Season 1 tunes 17 guns, mostly buffs: more range or damage for the Axion, M4, Kastov 762, Patriot XMR, Oris 8.6 and most SMGs. The Hyeon Burst's Hyperburst Apex loses a lot of damage, and the VEL 46 and APOC-338 are nerfed. Two new guns arrive, the Cronen Osprey assault rifle and the CSG-35 SMG, and Claymores and Proximity Mines now arm in 0.75 seconds.
17 guns tuned · 4 tier moves · 27 new builds
Nov 2, 2026
Nov 2 update
No weapon tuning this time, but our main stat tracker's Nov 2 ranking moved four guns. The Hyeon Burst is now top meta, the Oden moves up, and the M4 and Kastov 762 each drop a tier.
4 tier moves
Oct 28, 2026
Oct 28 update
The first weapon tuning pass since launch. Every SMG now does full damage on arm and hand shots, three ARs got more range, and the HAN 86 and Oden lost chest damage.
15 guns tuned · 15 tier moves · 6 new builds
